bot.name: Loans & Financial Services Lead to Advisor Appointment
bot.description: Automation-first loan assistant that captures structured lending requirements, produces indicative guidance, saves qualified lead data, supports status lookups, accepts document uploads, books advisor consultations, and schedules follow-up.
bot.headerTagline: Financial lead qualification and advisor booking

messages.text:
👋 Welcome!

I can help you explore loan options, understand general eligibility requirements, prepare required documents, check an existing request, and schedule a discussion with a loan advisor.

What would you like help with?
Choose an option or type your loan requirement directly.
I can answer general loan process questions, but final eligibility, pricing, approval, exceptions, and document verification are handled only by the authorised lending team.

messages: Share your name, mobile number, and the loan requirement so I can connect you with an advisor.
Connecting you to a loan advisor with your requirement context.

messages.text: Select the loan type to view the usual document checklist.
Select your employment type.
Tell me the loan type and approximate requirement. Example: I need a home loan around 40 lakhs.
Which type of loan are you interested in?

messages: To continue, please enter your mobile number.

messages.text: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your mobile number.

data.script: const otp = String(vars.customer_mobile_otp || "").trim(); vars.customer_mobile_otp_route = /^\d{6}$/.test(otp) ? "valid" : "retry"; return "success";

messages.text: That OTP format is invalid. Please enter a 6-digit OTP.
Enter the 6-digit OTP again.

data.script: const otp = String(vars.customer_mobile_otp || "").trim(); vars.customer_mobile_otp_route = /^\d{6}$/.test(otp) ? "valid" : "retry"; return "success";

messages.text: That OTP format is still invalid. Please try one final time with a 6-digit OTP.

Choose how to continue.

messages: Great. I need a few details to continue.
What loan amount do you want to explore?
Share your income and employment profile for initial guidance.
Tell me the remaining requirement details.
